suggestions.title: Project story
suggestions.description: A write-up of a garden the studio designed and built, covering the site, the client's brief, the planting choices and how the garden has turned out.
suggestions.why: Three entries (the Corbridge walled garden revisit, the Prudhoe school garden and the Allendale Mill courtyard) each tell the story of one named Northfold project from site to result.

suggestions.title: Gardening guide
suggestions.description: A practical explainer on one gardening technique or planting idea, telling readers why it is worth doing and how to go about it.
suggestions.why: Three entries (making a meadow, rain gardens and winter-structure plants) each take one topic and give hands-on advice that a reader could apply to their own garden.

suggestions.title: Studio news
suggestions.description: A first-person update about Northfold itself, such as an anniversary, a new team member or a first venture, written to share the studio's life with readers.
suggestions.why: Three entries (the ten-year anniversary, the welcome for Hannah and the first show garden) are about the studio rather than a client garden or a technique.

suggestions.title: Seasonal jobs
suggestions.description: A checklist-style piece setting out which garden jobs to do in a given season, and in what order or priority.
suggestions.why: Two entries (spring jobs and late autumn jobs) are organised around a time of year and work through a list of tasks for that season.
